name: product-page
useFor: Use for a product or feature page. Pass `rows` of label, title, description and a `visual` (a library item with sample data). Keep pictures to real parts, never screenshots.
constraints: Screenshots or stock photos as pictures
source: Mireye website (mireye-website, read-only): ProductPages and FeatureRow (copy beside a product picture, alternating)
title: Product page
description: A product or features page: the hero with a cited answer as its picture, alternating feature rows that each show a real library part (a request, cited fields, the buy box checks), the field grid, questions and the closing card.
